rules: Monthly boost caps: the METO account gets $100 (two $50 boosts). @dromavi gets $100, and METO pieces use none of it. The Q4 plan gives @prometrausa $0, organic only. The newer Sep 25 PROMETRA meeting said PROMETRA-only posts should get targeted ads and boosts, so that line is open (see decisions). All caps wait on Dr. Bailey's yes on Mon Sep 28.

The comment test: a post needs 10 organic MOVEMENT comments in 48 hours before any money goes in. Elsewhere, comments can be counted by hand until the MOVEMENT auto-reply is confirmed working. On the METO account, no confirmed auto-reply means no boost, and the deadline to confirm it is Fri Oct 2. Nothing is boosted on post day.
The run: $50 for 7 days, launched on a weekday at the 48-hour read. The day-3 cost is recorded. On @dromavi, a run above $1.50 per follow at day 3 is paused.

Never boost trauma, PTSD or fear videos, or videos that call out a race. The journey film, family and kids, donations and the DNA reveal also stay organic. So do sacred material (the Star, Vodun Day), political content and live-event promos.

Public ad copy: no prices, dates, deadlines, seats remaining, scholarship counts or age line. Never address the viewer's ethnicity or ancestry in the second person. Never use life-changing, once in a lifetime, guaranteed, full ride, free trip, or safe as a promise.
Paid ads go to warm audiences only. Pilgrimage ads leave out anyone who already applied.
Stop rule for the photo ads: after 7 days, an ad that costs twice the group's average stops, and its budget moves to the best performer. Each ad gets two versions at most.
No Aug 22 ad runs paid with the 18 to 25 line. The C0682 yellow-fever sentence never runs.

decisions: Mon Sep 28: approve the boost caps and the 48-hour comment test. Then choose who runs the ads. Dr. Bailey can boost from his own ad account, or Mojes can run them with the caps in writing.

@prometrausa: the Q4 plan (Sep 24) gives it $0. But the Sep 25 PROMETRA meeting said posts only about PROMETRA should get targeted ads and boosts on that account. Eight new PROMETRA short-video scripts (PROMETRA Scripts v1) were also drafted Sep 26. Which rule holds?

Should the photo ads (A1 to A6, A5b) and the 25 scripted video ads run at all? The Sep 24 Q4 plan funds only $50 boosts inside the caps and has no line for them. If yes, the Sep 2 checklist comes first: the pixel on the start page, the four audiences and the applicant list, real photos, and the budget and ad account in writing.
Seats: Nehanda needs to confirm whether seats remain after Oct 1 and Oct 20. The answer gates D1 to D3, P1 to P4, O2, O4 and the 'fifty' piece.
Approve 'I'm taking fifty people home' as the story framing, and decide whether 'this January' may appear on organic METO pieces.
Sign off the 11 flagged video scripts: R-A, R-F, C3, C4, O3 (faith), O4 (companions and minors), O5 (agenda), O6, and D1 to D3.

Course link: the Sep 25 PROMETRA meeting moves the free curriculum from Teachable to the new METO web app in early October. Every course ad and METO boost points to metomovement.com/curriculum, so that link must reach the new sign-up. Also settle 12 or 13 modules, since photo ads A3 and A4 say twelve.

Tone: the Sep 16 METO meeting asked for an uplifting tone, not slavery-centered, which conflicts with the Crossing scripts 38 to 42. Photo ad A3 and video ad R-F target viewers of those videos. Should they run?

Meta setup: Meta requires an advertiser check for ads on social issues, and heritage content counts. Nehanda owns that step. Also needed: the ad account, the tracking pixel on the landing page, and which METO Instagram handle to use. Audience W2 names @metomovement.
Give Mojes read access to Meta Business Suite so ad results can be reported. It is due Fri Oct 2.
Send the campus list (with Nehanda) for the ambassador boost targeting. It is due Wed Oct 14 and blocks the Oct 19 boost.
